name: sendero
description: Create and adapt local-first travel itineraries with live context, realistic routes, and reservation planning.

interface.shortDescription: Plan trips around real places, local culture, and your constraints
interface.longDescription: Build practical itineraries from dates, lodging, transport preferences, interests, weather, local events, reservations, and daily routes. Reorganize plans while preserving fixed activities and confirmed bookings.
defaultPrompt: Build my trip around where I am staying.
Mix essential sights with places locals enjoy.
Adapt my trip around weather and bookings.
